description: Run the shop's manufacturability check on ONE offer whose manufacturability_check.status is "unchecked" (the price stands from the shop's own pricing, but no shop was asked for that material / finish yet) or still "checking". The network asks that shop once for exactly this option — its material, gauge, finish, quantity and the quote's destination — and lands the answer on the SAME offer: passed (orderable at the shown price), repriced (the shop priced it higher; the detail says so), or failed (the shop declined it). Call it when the user settles on such an offer and before create_checkout (checkout refuses an unchecked offer). Waits up to wait_s (default 45) for the shop; pending: true means the shop is still answering — re-read the quote shortly. Nothing else on the quote changes.

offer_id.description: The offer to have the shop confirm

quote_id.description: The quote the offer belongs to

wait_s.description: Seconds to wait for the shop (default 45)

name: check_offer
title: Ask the shop to confirm an offer
